text: Hello, boys and girls.How are you?Nice to see you.I'm 王尹婷。我来自于上海市实验学校。Welcome to my English class.In this period, we are going to focus on reading.You will learn about the features of picture diaries, get to know some new words, and look for key details about time, activities, and thoughts about someone's farm life.I hope that you will have a lot of fun in today's class.Are you ready for the class?Please get your student's book, worksheet, and pen ready.Now, please look at the pictures and review what you have learned.What did 王尹婷 see?What is each picture about?He saw signs about how we should get along with animals.Good.What does each sign mean?The first sign means we shouldn't feed or pet animals.How about the second sign?It means do not make the chickens angry.They pack.Exactly.How about the third one?It means there are bees around.Don't leave sweet foods outside.Bees like them.How about the last one?It means do not make loud noises.We had a revision of the meanings of the signs on the farm.王尹婷 did a lot of work on the farm.He wrote about the day in his picture diary.What does diary mean?We use a diary to record what happens in our daily life or to write down things we plan to do.In Chinese, it is called 日记 or 日记簿.What is a picture diary?A picture diary is a diary with pictures.What did 王尹婷 probably do on the farm?Maybe he fed some of the farm animals.Or perhaps he cleaned the places where the animals live.Good guess.Then what did 王尹婷 probably write about in the picture diary?He probably wrote about his day, his experiences, or feelings on the farm.Excellent.Based on these pictures, can you guess the answers to these questions?What is the farm like?What's your idea, Tina?There are many different animals on the farm.Maybe the farm is big.Fantastic answer.What kind of day did 王尹婷 probably have on the farm?The farm is big.What kind of day did 王尹婷 probably have?Maybe he had an unusual day.The chicken is flying over his head and it seems to peck him.It's quite a funny and unusual situation for him.Very good.You noticed the details in the picture.Perhaps he did some farm work and met some lovely animals.I agree with you.Maybe he had a special day so he wrote about it in his picture diary.Brilliant.Please take a look at 王尹婷's diary and take the things you find in it.Read the diary and do C3 on page 75.C3Have you finished?Let's check the answers.What do we find in 王尹婷's diary?We find day.What day was it?It was Saturday.We can also find place.Where was 王尹婷 that day?He was on Uncle Lin's farm.What else can we find?Events.Since that happened in Chinese, we say 發生的事情.These are the events on the farm, right?Besides these, we can also find date.What date was it?It was November the 16th.Anything else?Weather.What was the weather like?It was sunny.What else?Feelings and thoughts are included.What were 王尹婷's feelings and thoughts?What an unforgettable day.And we can also find pictures.王尹婷 drew these colorful and lovely pictures in his diary.And all these parts make a picture diary.You have got a good understanding of the general idea of the picture diary.Let's get down to details.Here is a table showing the details of 王尹婷's day on the farm.Look at the second column.What does chores mean?Chores refer to the regular tasks that you do.In Chinese, we say 日常事務,例行工作Please read closely and complete the table on page 75.日常事務日常事務Have you finished?At 7am, 王尹婷 fed the animals.What were his feelings or thoughts then?How interesting.Adjectives can help to paint a picture of the character's emotions and feelings within the picture diary.The word interesting shows how 王尹婷 feels.Let's check the timeline.What time adverbial goes after 7am?After that.What was 王尹婷's chore then?Hunting the goats.What about his feelings or thoughts at that moment?Clever dog, cookie.Great.Clever is an important word.Why was the dog described as clever?Because the farm dog helped direct the goats from the yard to the field.What does direct mean here?To tell or show someone how to get somewhere.In Chinese, direct means 指路,領路農場的狗幫忙把山羊從院子領到地裡Farm dogs seem to be big helpers on the farm, don't you agree?Let's move on.The time will be at 10 o'clock.What about chores?What kind of chores did he do at 10 o'clock?Milking the cows.What does milk mean here?No, it doesn't make sense.Then what does it mean?Here, milk is a verb.It means to take milk from a cow or goat.而milking是一個動名詞,相當於一個名詞Besides milking the cows, what else did Yiming do at that time?Taking some notes.He took some notes.Why did he take notes?What notes did he probably take?Maybe because Yiming has no experience in milking the cowsand he is writing down the important steps of milking the cows.What were his thoughts then?It was so cool.What time adverbial goes after that?In the afternoon.What chores did he do then?Cleaning the pig's tie.And what did Yiming learn about pigs?Pigs like to sleep in a clean place.Interesting.How did Yiming feel then?I was glad to be of help.What adjective do we have here?Glad.What is the last time adverbial?Before dinner.What was the chore?Collecting eggs.What was he thinking then?You will never believe this.Why did Yiming feel this way?Because something unexpected or unbelievable happened.A hen flew up and packed Yiming.Why did the hen pack Yiming?Probably because Yiming took its egg and it was angry.Yes, that sounds reasonable.Let's read the last sentence in Yiming's picture diary.Think about the question.Why was it an unforgettable day for Yiming?This is the opinion from my student Jason.Because he met many amazing animals on the farm and did a lot of chores there.He also met something interesting there.It was a special day for him.I think that's a wonderful answer.Good job, Jason.You see, Yiming updated his WeChat.And this is his new moment.Let's check it out.His family and friends were curious about what he did on the farm.And what made the day special and unforgettable.And many of them commented on his new moment.Can you complete their questions and answers based on what you read about Wang Yiming's picture diary?Let's take a look.What do you think of Lucia's work?Would you like to share your ideas, Michelle?Did Lucia show reasonable imagination?I think so.She asked about different aspects of Yiming's day and further explored the details of the farm dog.I think she showed great imagination in making the conversation.I can't agree with you more, Michelle.Well done, Lucia.Today, we read Wang Yiming's picture diary about his unforgettable day on Uncle Ling's farm,learned some new words and learned to look for key details about time, activities and thoughts about Yiming's farm life.I hope that you have had a lot of fun in today's lesson.Well, so much for today.Here's your homework.One, read aloud the text after the recording for at least three times.Two, complete the summary with proper words.Three, complete the exercises on page 64, workbook 6A.Thank you for your listening.Goodbye, class.
